sources.title: FINUFFT inverse tutorial
sources.scope: Exact sampling matrices can be ill-conditioned despite oversampling; gaps and the approximation space matter.

sources.title: Geo-FNO, JMLR 2023
sources.scope: Learned coordinate deformation to a regular latent domain; arbitrary geometry alone does not certify wave accuracy.

sources.title: GINO, NeurIPS 2023
sources.scope: Graph integration with geometric weights and Fourier latent layers; check appendix on Riemann weights and the specific CFD benchmark.

sources.title: NUNO, ICML 2023
sources.scope: Domain partition and interpolation to local regular grids; it manages representation error rather than removing information loss.

sources.title: Discretization mismatch, ICLR 2025
sources.scope: Resolution-independent parameters do not guarantee consistent inference across meshes; aliasing is material.

sources.title: Patel, Subedi and Tewari, 2026 revision
sources.scope: Structured linear estimator for a fixed prescribed Hamiltonian; weak unitarity, smoothness assumptions and time-generalization limits. Not nonlinear self-gravitating SP.

sources.title: Auzinger et al., 2016
sources.scope: Finite-element Strang splitting for SP has rigorous convergence results under stated regularity and homogeneous Dirichlet assumptions.

sources.title: Kormann, 2016
sources.scope: High-order Gauss-Lobatto finite elements and Magnus-Lanczos with adaptive error control for Schrodinger evolution.

sources.title: Li, Appelo and Zhang, 2021
sources.scope: Accuracy results for spectral elements applied to wave and linear Schrodinger equations.

sources.title: MFEM performance documentation
sources.scope: Matrix-free tensor-product operator application and multigrid preconditioning provide a credible 3D implementation route, not a measured SP speedup.

sources.title: Halo convergence target
sources.scope: Whole-halo convergence and matched N-body comparisons matter; a fitted central soliton or NFW shape alone is insufficient.
